style: Loose wet-on-wet oil paint animation in the manner of paint-on-glass animation: smooth, blended oil paint laid in long sweeping curved brushstrokes, soft smeared edges, forms simplified to a few strokes, faint canvas texture, figures faceless with no facial features. The image is an irregular pool of painted light with brushy swept edges floating in pure black, the black covering roughly half of the frame. Palette: pure black, warm cream-yellow light, pale bone white, dusty blue-grey, umber; cold periwinkle blue-violet for night, snow and sky; at most one small red accent. Tall vertical 9:16 cinematic composition: one subject, centred, with the action in the upper two-thirds of the frame and only dark paint in the bottom fifth. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no signature, no frame border.
king: the lone king: a thin upright faceless figure in a long pale bone-white cloak falling to the floor and a simple thin gold band crown with one small red gem; his head is a soft pale shape with no features

ref.prompt: Full-length portrait of {king}, standing in three-quarter view, filling the height of a tall vertical frame against pure black, lit from upper left as a pool of painted light. {style}

shots.still: Tall vertical shot from behind and above: {king} stands at the gilded balustrade of a vast golden balcony in the upper third of the frame, right hand lowered at his side, looking down over an immense sea of hundreds of tiny kneeling, bowed figures filling the frame below him in rows like the waves of an ocean, everything in gold and cream-yellow strokes against a near-black night. {style}
shots.motion: The king slowly raises his right hand and the rows of tiny kneeling figures ripple outward like a wave across a sea. Very slow push in. Oil-painting brushstrokes shimmer. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: A bare stone cell in cold blue-violet darkness, tall and narrow: rough stone blocks, one tall slit window high above, {king} sits alone on a low stone bench in the middle of the frame, head slightly bowed, a single candle on the floor before him casting a small cream-yellow pool of light, vast empty dark above and around him. {style}
shots.motion: The candle flame flickers gently; the king sits still and slowly lowers his head. Very slow push in, brushstrokes drift slightly. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: A painted crowd seen from below: countless raised arms rendered as warm cream-yellow upward brushstrokes rising through the middle of the frame, and high above the hands, in the upper third, a simple gold crown with one small red gem lifted aloft, catching the light. Faces indistinct. {style}
shots.motion: The arms rise and sway upward in slow waves and the crown is lifted higher. Slow upward tilt, paint strokes flowing. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Two ivory dice with dark pips tumbling in mid-air in the centre of a tall near-black canvas, painted in thick oil brushstrokes, cream-yellow highlights and cold blue-violet shadows, a few flecks of gold paint around them. {style}
shots.motion: The dice tumble and rotate in extreme slow motion, then come apart into ribbons of drifting gold paint that swirl and float away into the dark. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: A golden palace standing high on tall slender pillars of pale sand and white salt crystals that rise from the darkness at the bottom of the frame, the palace glowing cream-yellow and gold in the upper third, the pillars grainy and crystalline, a cold blue-violet night sky behind. {style}
shots.motion: The pillars of sand and salt slowly crumble, grains pouring down like hourglass sand, and the palace begins to sag. Slow push in. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: A black horse-drawn carriage with two small lamps fleeing at night up a narrow road that recedes toward the top of the frame through a blue-violet painted landscape, tall walls of dark brushstrokes rising on both sides like a canyon, moonlit cream highlights on the carriage. Seen from behind and low. {style}
shots.motion: The carriage races away down the road while the painted walls on both sides slowly lean in and close in, brushstrokes streaking with speed. Camera follows. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Close-up of a pale hand emerging from a bone-white cloak sleeve into the centre of the frame, palm open, holding an old ornate gold key, near-black around it, cold blue-violet shadows and cream highlights. {style}
shots.motion: The key slowly dissolves into flakes and strands of gold paint that drift off the open palm and scatter into the dark; the hand stays still. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Large bronze church bells hanging one above another in a tall dark belfry with heavy wooden beams, seen from below against a black night sky, cream-yellow highlights on the bronze, cold blue-violet shadows. {style}
shots.motion: The bells swing slowly back and forth; with each swing a ring of pale cream paint expands outward through the dark air like a sound wave. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Ghostly pale translucent horsemen gathering on a distant snowy field in the middle of the frame under a tall cold blue-violet night sky, their figures made of pale cream-white brushstrokes, faceless, snow in the foreground. {style}
shots.motion: More ghostly horsemen emerge from the mist and slowly gather into a line while snow drifts across the field. Slow lateral drift. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Over-the-shoulder view from behind {king}, standing before a tall gilt-framed mirror in a dark room that fills the upper two-thirds of the frame; in the silvered glass his reflection is soft and faceless and the reflected gold crown has a jagged crack running through it. Cold blue-violet light, cream highlights. {style}
shots.motion: Slow push in toward the mirror while the crack in the reflected crown slowly spreads; the king stands still. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Tall double palace doors bursting open inward under a violent wind of swirling brushstrokes, a tall leaded window above them shattering into glittering shards of cream-yellow light, dark interior, a cold blue-violet storm outside. {style}
shots.motion: A violent wind of brushstrokes blows the doors wide open; the windows shatter and shards of light fly toward the camera in slow motion. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Dark faceless silhouettes of a crowd pouring in through tall open palace doors, backlit by cold blue-violet light, high above them in the upper third one red flag on a pole, the only red in the image. {style}
shots.motion: The silhouetted crowd surges forward through the doors toward the camera while the red flag waves slowly above them. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: A small wooden marionette made to look like the king, with a pale bone-white cloak and a tiny gold crown, dangling limp in the centre of a tall near-black frame from one single thin golden thread that runs up out of the top of the frame, lit from above by a cold blue-violet light; clearly a wooden puppet with jointed wooden limbs. {style}
shots.motion: The wooden marionette sways gently on its single thread; the thread is snipped near the top and the puppet drops softly down out of frame into the darkness. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: Pure black darkness with a single thin vertical slit of cream-white light standing tall in the distance, like a tall door opened a crack; a pale cloaked silhouette seen from behind walks away toward it in the lower middle of the frame, small. Visible brushstrokes in the black. {style}
shots.motion: The pale silhouette slowly walks away toward the thin vertical frame of light, growing smaller. One continuous shot, no cuts.

shots.still: A simple gold band crown with one small red gem falling through pure darkness in the centre of a tall frame, close-up, thick oil paint brushstrokes, cream-yellow highlights on the gold, near-black all around. {style}
shots.motion: The crown falls, lands on the dark floor, bounces once and rolls slowly away into the darkness until it disappears. One continuous shot, no cuts.
